book.title: 我想去洗手间，可以举手吗？
book.subtitle: 身体的小信号最重要

moral.zh: 规则是为了照顾大家，而身体的健康永远排在第一位；有需要就勇敢举手。
moral.en: Rules help care for everyone, and our body's health always comes first; raise your hand bravely when you need to.

pages.zhText: 大班的故事时间到了。林老师坐在大家面前，打开一本关于大鲸鱼的绘本，开始讲起来。
pages.enText: It was story time in the oldest kindergarten class. Teacher Lin sat with the children and opened a picture book about a great whale.

pages.zhText: 教室里安安静静的，大家都在聚精会神地听着。窗外小树叶在风里轻轻摇晃。
pages.enText: The room was peaceful and quiet as everyone listened intently. Outside, young leaves rustled gently in the morning breeze.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Classroom middle shot: neat rows of low desks, quiet atmosphere, sunlight streaming through large classroom windows.

pages.zhText: 安安坐在第三排，两只手规规矩矩地放在膝盖上。突然，她觉得肚子里“咕噜”响了一声，小肚子变得鼓鼓胀胀的。
pages.enText: An'an sat in the third row with hands folded on her knees. Suddenly, her tummy gave a soft rumble and felt uncomfortably full.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Medium desk shot: An'an sits upright, but her eyebrows knit together and hands move instinctively toward her lower tummy.
pages.generationPrompt: Medium desk shot: An'an sits upright, but her eyebrows knit together and hands move instinctively toward her lower tummy.

pages.zhText: “我想去洗手间了……”安安望向门口。故事讲到一半，她却不知道该不该现在开口。
pages.enText: “I need the bathroom,” An'an thought, looking toward the door. The story was halfway through, and she was unsure whether to speak up.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Close portrait: An'an looks worried, shifting slightly in her wooden chair, eyes darting toward the classroom door.
pages.generationPrompt: Close portrait: An'an looks worried, shifting slightly in her wooden chair, eyes darting toward the classroom door.

pages.zhText: 她想起开学第一天老师说的纪律：“上课时要保持安静，不随意走动。”安安把两只脚并得紧紧的，不敢乱动一下。
pages.enText: She remembered the first-day rule: “Stay quiet during class and do not wander.” An'an clamped her feet tight, afraid to move.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Low shot: An'an's legs pressed firmly together, white-red sneakers planted side by side, knees trembling with strain.
pages.generationPrompt: Low shot: An'an's legs pressed firmly together, white-red sneakers planted side by side, knees trembling with strain.

pages.zhText: 林老师翻开下一页，讲到了大鲸鱼喷出高高的水花。全班同学都笑了起来，可安安却一点儿也笑不出声来。
pages.enText: Teacher Lin turned the page to a whale spouting water. The class laughed in delight, but An'an could not even smile.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Medium classroom shot: other kids smiling at the book; An'an sits stiffly with pale cheeks and tense clenched fists.

pages.zhText: 随着时间的过去，肚子胀得越来越厉害，像装了一个快要吹爆的小气球。安安的额头甚至渗出了一颗颗亮晶晶的小汗珠。
pages.enText: As minutes ticked by, her tummy felt like a balloon stretched to bursting. Tiny beads of sweat appeared on her forehead.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Close portrait: An'an bites her lower lip, sweating softly at temple, eyes brimming with held-back tears of discomfort.

pages.zhText: “现在举手，老师会不会当着全班同学批评我下课没去厕所？”安安心里像打鼓一样七上八下，手缩在桌子下面直打颤。
pages.enText: “If I raise my hand now, will the teacher scold me in front of everyone?” Her heart drummed in panic; her hands shook under the desk.

pages.zhText: 同桌乐乐注意到了安安的不自在。乐乐侧过身，悄悄拉了拉安安的衣角：“安安，你怎么啦？脸都白了。”
pages.enText: Desk partner Lele noticed her discomfort. He leaned in and tugged her sleeve softly: “An'an, what's wrong? You look pale.”

pages.zhText: “我想去洗手间……但我不敢举手。”安安带着哭腔小声说。
pages.enText: “I need the bathroom... but I'm scared to raise my hand,” An'an whispered with a catch in her throat.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Close two-person view: An'an whispers to Lele with watery eyes; Lele listens with an earnest, supportive nod.

pages.zhText: “可以告诉老师你需要帮助。”乐乐轻声鼓励她，“不用一直忍着，我陪你举一下手。”
pages.enText: “You can tell the teacher you need help,” Lele encouraged softly. “You do not have to hold it. I can raise a hand with you.”

pages.zhText: 安安深吸了一口气。她想起了妈妈说过的话：“身体不舒服时，一定要第一时间告诉大人。”
pages.enText: An'an took a deep breath. She remembered Mom's words: “Whenever your body feels uncomfortable, tell a grown-up right away.”

pages.enText: An'an raised her right arm straight up into the air. “Teacher Lin... may I go to the bathroom?” Her voice was soft, but clear.

parentGuide.goal: 破除孩子对课堂纪律的绝对恐惧，赋予在集体生活中坦荡表达生理需求的勇气。
parentGuide.reminder: 如厕、口渴或身体不适可以随时告知成人，不要求孩子憋到活动结束。成人主动说明求助方法；着急时可以直接开口，不必等举手获准。按园所实际动线提供成人照看，并保护如厕隐私。
questions: 安安想去洗手间时，为什么一开始不敢举手？
老师是怎么告诉全班小朋友的？
parentGuide.activity: 在家和孩子进行一次“小课堂模拟”，练习挺直后背举手、声音清晰地说出“老师我想喝水/去洗手间”。

ageTips.age4to5: 允许孩子用指图、点头、手势等非语言方式表达；共读以倾听、感受安抚为主，不强求马上做到。
ageTips.age6to8: 讨论大班一日生活中的真实感受与解决策略，鼓励孩子自己提出小行动，家长承担托底支持与陪伴责任。
